components.name: useDockInset
components.summary: The bottom padding a scroll view's content needs so nothing rests under a floating dock: wrap the screen in DockInsetProvider, give the scroll content paddingBottom: useDockInset().
components.use: The bottom padding scroll content needs so nothing rests under a floating dock: wrap the screen in DockInsetProvider, give the scroll content paddingBottom: useDockInset(). The kit's overlay TabBar and an absolutely placed BottomBar report themselves; a template's own dock (TabDock, PillDock) puts onLayout={useReportDock({ bottom })} on its outer view. dockInset() is the pure sum: height + bottom offset + safe area not already counted + a 16 pt gap; two docks take the larger, 0 with none.

evidence.note: p0.overlap (content under a floating dock at rest) was the most frequent blocking failure of the template factory's batches 23, 25 and 26: builders padded scroll content by hand (dock height + 16 pt) and many forgot
